en.text: Will the weather hold today? Smoke's going straight up. No wind, no rain. We'll get the corn in.
en.prompt: Medium close-up at the doorway of an Iron Age roundhouse at dawn, lit by the low sun from the right and the hearth glow behind her. The woman keeps her head and eyes turned three-quarters to the right, toward her husband standing off-screen right, for the whole shot, and speaks, calmly, "Will the weather hold today? Smoke's going straight up. No wind, no rain. We'll get the corn in." She glances up at the smoke once, then back to him. Natural blinks, small head movements; she never faces the camera. Keep the still's light and colours. Natural skin texture, no CGI gloss, no text.
